summary: First full E2E pass of CIRCLE (backend pytest 27/27 + Playwright UI on desktop 1920 and mobile 390). Covered RBAC, demo login + isolation, tasks (create title-only / full panel, board drag persist, list inline edits, group-by assignee/label, column hide, saved views, label filter, CSV/JSON export incl. escaping, done -> completed_at/by + activity, archive), task detail (comment @mention, checklist, subtask, upload attachment, card color, review approve), chat (Enter send, reply, react, edit, delete, pin, emoji, sticker, poll create+vote, DM via New message, voice call start/join/leave), private group 404 for non-member, groups create/join/edit/archive, directory grid/list/search, profile self-edit, phone visibility, org chart add/rename/move-via-table/delete-with-reassign/export, settings dark mode persist, theme editor save/reset, contrast warning, dashboard background persist, widget hide/reorder/restore, notifications + mark all read, Ctrl+K global search, mobile bottom nav / More drawer / chat composer / board horizontal scroll / no page overflow. Found and fixed 2 bugs (dashboard widgets rendered twice; regex 500 on task/message search). Remaining issues are minor.

minor.issue: FIXED BY TESTER: unescaped user input was used as a Mongo $regex, so '(' or '[' caused 500 (OperationFailure). Now wrapped in re.escape.
Task results include archived tasks (no archived:{$ne:true} filter); also groups search includes archived groups.

'tasks:changed' websocket event goes to every connected user in all workspaces (demo + internal), not just the actor's workspace. It only triggers refetches, but it's still a cross-tenant leak and wastes requests.
online_now counts all websocket connections across workspaces (demo users are counted in ws_internal stats).

Mentions match on '@FirstName' only. '@Test Employee' mentioned both Test Admin and Test Employee (mention_ids=[test_admin_1,test_emp_1]). Colleagues who share a first name will get the wrong mentions.
There is no DELETE endpoint for tasks, only archive. Fine by spec, but test data can only be archived.

ui_bugs.issue: FIXED BY TESTER: if the user had no saved dashboard.order, the order became DEFAULT_ORDER twice, so every widget showed two times (seen for demo_saeful). Fixed in Dashboard.jsx (baseOrder + Set dedupe).
After renaming a group via Edit group, the chat header updates but the left conversation list keeps the old name until reload.
Picking a quick reaction (react-*) doesn't close the dropdown. The next click on the trigger closes it instead of opening it.
When filters return 0 rows (e.g. Archived + label filter), the list area is completely blank, with no empty-state message.

issues: Uses the browser's native datetime-local picker instead of the shadcn calendar
The text input is squeezed so the placeholder is cut off ('Add meetin', 'Add remind')
Deadline/start use native date/time inputs instead of the shadcn calendar. A date-only deadline shows as 05:00 PM in the detail even though deadline_has_time=false
The focus outline is a red rectangle that sits only around part of the input and doesn't follow the rounded modal corners
A '+ Poll' text link sits cramped below the composer at the bottom-left edge with little padding

action_items: Scope the tasks:changed broadcast (and admin online_now) to users of the same workspace
Resolve mentions by user_id from a suggestion picker (or match the full name) instead of first name only
Refresh the conversation list after group edit/rename
Close the message-actions dropdown after a quick reaction
Add an empty state to the task list view when there are no rows
Replace native date/datetime inputs (dashboard meetings/reminders, task deadline/start) with shadcn Calendar/Popover, and widen the reminder/meeting text inputs
Polish the global search focus ring, the mobile '+ Poll' placement and the 'votes' plural
critical_code_review_comments: routes_tasks.build_query and routes_chat.messages used raw user input in $regex (fixed with re.escape). Check any other $regex usage.
GET /api/tasks/{id} and comments don't check visibility beyond workspace. Any workspace member can read or comment on any task. Acceptable for an internal workspace, but worth confirming.
Endpoints accept raw dict Body without Pydantic models. Validation is done by hand and is inconsistent (e.g. card_color, checklist shape and deadline format aren't validated).
routes_chat.py is 546 lines and growing; consider splitting calls/polls/stickers into their own modules.
Sync `requests` calls (object storage, OAuth session-data) run inside async endpoints and block the event loop; use httpx.AsyncClient or run_in_threadpool.

success_rate.backend: 100% (27/27 after fix; 3 regex 500s found and fixed)
success_rate.frontend: ~95% (all requested flows work; 1 high-priority widget duplication fixed; minor UX/design items open)

rca of the issue: Dashboard duplicate widgets: order = [...(dash.order||DEFAULT).filter(..), ...DEFAULT.filter(k => !(dash.order||[]).includes(k))]. With dash.order undefined, the second list is the full DEFAULT again. Search 500: a raw string was passed to Mongo $regex, so invalid patterns raise OperationFailure (code 51091).
